target_customer: Satellite operators and launch customers needing propulsion
problem: Satellites carry limited fuel, so propulsion cost and propellant mass limit mission life and economics.
business_model: Hardware development for propulsion and launch systems; funded by equity crowdfunding
product_category: Space propulsion (electric propulsion at YC; later described as reusable hydrogen rocket engines)

founders.name: Kyle Flanagan
founders.background_notes: YC page names him as the only founder. Search snippets mention SpaceX work, but no opened source confirms it.

technical_complexity.rationale: Propulsion hardware needs in-space testing, specialist materials and launch access, research-grade for a one-person startup.

defensibility.rationale: Hardware qualification and flight heritage are slow to copy, but no evidence shows the company reached either.

market_need_then: Small satellite constellations were growing in 2016 and search results show micro-propulsion startups taking orders, but a source dated near the batch was not opened.

branding.domain_note: The company domain primelightworks.com now redirects to an unrelated site, so the original domain appears lost or abandoned.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found and the original website no longer serves the company.

pivots.from: Solar-powered electric propulsion for satellites (YC page)
pivots.to: Reusable green hydrogen rocket engines for satellite launches (StartEngine listing per search results)

outcome_analysis: Prime Lightworks was a one-founder space propulsion startup in YC Summer 2016. Its website now redirects elsewhere and the only later trace is a Regulation CF crowdfunding listing around 2023 for a different engine concept, with conflicting totals from aggregators. The status is unknown, so no cause of failure or success can be stated from public sources.
notes: Website is dead or hijacked: the fetch hit a 308 redirect to an unrelated French site, not followed. Funding unverified: StartEngine listing (page fetch returned empty) was described in search results with a 3.28 dollar share price, 19.64M valuation and April 12, 2023 deadline; CB Insights says 1.8M over 6 rounds and VCBacked says 24K total, so no round is recorded. Competitor list left empty: Accion Systems and Busek turned up in a search but the sources were undated or not near mid-2016. Status Active comes from the YC page only and may be stale.
